propDocs.Select.multiple: Allows several values; the popup stays open while choosing.
propDocs.Select.required: Requires a value for form submission.
propDocs.Select.dismissible: Allows outside presses and Escape to close the popup.
propDocs.Select.presentation: Chooses popover, sheet, or automatic presentation.
propDocs.Select.modal: Controls outside pointer interaction and page modality.
propDocs.SelectContent.side: Preferred popup side, subject to available space.
propDocs.SelectContent.sideOffset: Gap between trigger and popup in pixels.
propDocs.SelectContent.alignItemWithTrigger: Overlaps the chosen row with the trigger.
